props.heading: Pieces made to be worn, not stored
props.sub: A small-batch boutique of handloom weaves and everyday essentials — sized honestly, finished properly.

props.label: Our Label
props.heading: Small batches, honest fabric
props.body:
We started in a two-room studio with a handful of weavers and a stubborn idea: make fewer things, and make them properly.

Everything is cut and finished in small runs, so a piece sells out rather than sits on sale. If something does not fit the way it should, bring it back — alterations on our own pieces are always free.

pillars.title: Handloom first
pillars.text: Woven by a co-operative we have worked with since day one.

pillars.title: Free alterations
pillars.text: Fit is the whole point. We alter our own pieces at no charge, for life.

pillars.title: Small runs
pillars.text: Limited pieces per design, so you rarely meet yourself at a party.

pillars.title: Easy exchanges
pillars.text: Seven days to exchange a size, in store or by courier.

props.label: The Collection
props.heading: Shop new arrivals
props.sub: Pick your size and options on any piece — live stock, add to cart, and pay however suits you.

items.title: Handloom Silk Saree
items.desc: Pure mulberry silk in aubergine with a woven gold zari border. Comes with an unstitched blouse piece.
items.body:
Woven on a pit loom over roughly nine days, this saree is pure mulberry silk with a traditional gold zari border.

The aubergine body deepens in low light, which is why it photographs so differently indoors and out. Each piece is finished by hand, so a slub or a slight shift in the weave is part of it, not a fault.

Dry clean only. Store folded in the muslin sleeve it arrives in, and refold along a different line every few months so the zari does not crease.

items.title: Chambray Print Shirt
items.desc: Soft indigo chambray with a hand-blocked motif. Cut a little roomy, meant to be worn untucked.
items.body:
A lightweight indigo chambray, hand-block printed in small runs so no two shirts carry exactly the same motif spacing.

Cut a little roomy through the body with a slightly dropped shoulder — it is meant to be worn untucked, over anything. The relaxed fit adds about two inches through the chest if you prefer more room.

Machine wash cold, inside out. The indigo will soften over the first few washes; that is the point.

items.title: Denim Shirt Dress
items.desc: Washed cotton denim, button-through, with a gathered waist and deep pockets.
items.body:
A washed cotton denim shirt dress that works over a year — sleeves rolled in summer, a knit underneath in winter.

Button-through the full length, gathered at the waist, with pockets deep enough to actually use. Falls just above the knee on most heights.

Machine wash cold with like colours. Expect a little fading at the seams over time.

items.title: Satin Jogger
items.desc: Fluid satin in blush, elasticated at the waist and ankle. Dressier than it sounds.
items.body:
A fluid satin jogger that reads far dressier than a jogger has any right to.

Elasticated at the waist and ankle, with patch pockets front and back. Wear it with the chambray shirt for something easy, or with heels when it needs to do more.

Hand wash cold or dry clean. Do not tumble dry — satin does not forgive it.

items.title: Occasion Gown
items.desc: Full-skirted crimson gown with a fitted bodice and a hidden side zip.
items.body:
A full-skirted crimson gown cut for occasions that deserve one — fitted through the bodice, with enough skirt to move properly.

Made to order in your size, which takes about ten days. Hidden side zip, boned bodice, fully lined. Because it is made for you, this piece is exchange-only rather than returnable.

Dry clean only.

items.title: The Everyday Edit
items.desc: Our staples bundle — leather belt, cotton tee and tailored trouser, priced together.
items.body:
The three pieces customers end up buying anyway, bundled at a better price: a full-grain leather belt, a heavyweight cotton tee and a pair of tailored trousers.

Pick the trouser size at checkout — the belt is cut to match, and the tee follows the same sizing as the rest of our knitwear.

notes: Built around the `products` section so the demo shows the full shop flow: nested attributes (Size/Fit, Border/Blouse), a variant matrix with per-combination price, MRP, SKU and live stock, plus cart, account and checkout via the header toggles. Some combinations are deliberately stock 0 so the Out-of-stock state and the disabled Add-to-Cart button are visible in a demo. Photos are hosted Unsplash URLs (SiteRenderer::media passes any http(s) URL through), so nothing lands in the client's media library — swap them for the shop's own product shots before going live. Per-colour option images are intentionally not set: attach those only when the photo genuinely matches the colour, or the main image will not change when a shopper picks one.
